meta.name: Someday or One Day 720p
meta.description: Yu-Hsuan lost her boyfriend Chuan-Sheng in plane accident. She then discovered Chuan-Sheng and a girl look alike Yu-Hsuan both appeared in a photo taken in 1998. Accidentally, she had backed to 1998 and met a boy looked alike Chuan-Sheng.

videos.title: When Longing Reached Me, I Realised How Distance You Were
videos.overview: Huang Yu Xian lost her boyfriend from a plane incident two years ago. She misses him a lot and sends messages with no reply. Meanwhile, her colleague claims there is an app that can find someone who looks identical to you.

videos.title: Your Presence is Enough to Occupy the Rest of My Life
videos.overview: Huang Yu Xuan is shocked to find out that her boyfriend was planning to propose to her. Meanwhile, through Ah Tuo's app, she finds a photo that has a woman who looks exactly like her and her boyfriend is beside the woman.

videos.title: Since Losing You, My World Can't Move Forward
videos.overview: Going to the past year, 17-year-old Chen Yun Ru meets her school friends Li Zi Wei and Mo Jun-Jie. Back to the present, Huang Yu Xuan is disappointed to find out that the man in the photo is not her boyfriend.

videos.title: All the Parting Is That I Am Practicing to Lose You
videos.overview: In 1998, Chen Yun Ru is unconscious in the hospital after a stranger's attack. Meanwhile, in the present, Huang Yu Xuan falls asleep listening to an old tape and wakes up, becoming Chen Yun Ru.

videos.title: How to Travel Through Time to Meet You Again
videos.overview: Chen Yun Ru thinks her being Huang Yu Xuan was all a dream. Meanwhile, Chen Yun Ru, Li Zi Wei and Mo Jun Jie try to find the attacker.

videos.title: It Has Run Out of the Gentle Part of Me When I Miss You
videos.overview: Huang Yu Xuan finds herself back in 2019, and although she goes to a mental hospital, the doctor does not believe her. Meanwhile, she receives Chen Yun Ru's diary from the 32 Cafe's owner.

videos.title: I Left Myself Stranded Slowly in Shattered Yesterday
videos.overview: Huang Yu Xuan prepares to go to Shanghai, but first she decides to go to the past once again; she finds out that Li Zi Wei and Wang Quan Sheng are different people, and she becomes confused that they look the same.

videos.title: Some Love Is Being Able to Travel Through Time and Still Come to You
videos.overview: Mo Jun Jie is accused of being the suspect in the attack of Chen Yun Ru, but they go to the police to prove he is innocent; Chen Yun Ru goes to her uncle to tell him she is Huang Yu Xuan, but he does not believe her.

videos.title: You Fall into My Dream Accidentally
videos.overview: Everyone is surprised to see Chen Yun Ru being so extroverted; Li Zi Wei feels jealous to see Mo Jun Jie and Chen Yun Ru become so close.

videos.title: I Would Rather Remember That You Never Left My World
videos.overview: Li Zi Wei encounters a lost girl, and he escorts her home safely; she tells him her name is Huang Yu Xuan and to never forget her; Li Zi Wei finds himself falling in love with Chen Yun Ru.
